blocks.text: The Melissa & Doug Get Well Doctor’s Kit Play Set provides everything kids need for pretend medical play. This 25-piece set includes a stethoscope, blood pressure cuff, thermometer, syringe, hearing tester, and more, all designed for realistic role play. A durable tote keeps the pieces organized and portable for house calls or easy storage. Children can check vital signs, give pretend shots, and write prescriptions, creating opportunities for role play that supports communication and problem-solving. This set also helps reduce anxiety about doctor visits by familiarizing kids with common tools and routines. Designed for ages 3 and up, the kit encourages hands-on, screen-free play that promotes empathy and social interaction. It pairs well with other Melissa & Doug role play sets for extended pretend scenarios at home or in group settings For more exciting pretend play, combine this set with the Melissa and Doug Vet Playset & Beauty Salon Playset, to build the ultimate pretend play world for hours of hands-on, screen-free play Wholesome Play for 35+ Years: Melissa & Doug inspires kid-powered play with its learning toys for kids, baby & toddler toys, puzzles, games, building toys & stuffed animals, dolls, & even a doll house
